findings.title: Reject extra arguments to inspect before entering preparation
findings.trigger: coding-job-prepare inspect SPEC AUTHORITY, with valid matching inputs and authority
findings.observed: The inspect branch returns only when args.len() == 3. With four arguments, execution passes the remaining length check and enters the preparation path without requiring args[1] == "prepare". Lines 274–283 create directories and begin writing the bundle.
findings.impact: An inspection invocation unexpectedly creates output, state and possibly operation directories. It also consumes the fresh-directory precondition, causing a subsequent intended preparation to fail.
findings.violated_outcome: The operator entry must preserve the distinction between observation-only inspection and explicitly selected preparation.
findings.status: Control flow observed in immutable source; runtime consequence inferred, not executed under the review grant.
findings.requested_change: Dispatch strictly on command and argument count: inspect requires three arguments; prepare requires four. Reject other combinations before mutation.
findings.validation_requested: Using otherwise valid preparation inputs, invoke inspect with an authority argument and assert refusal with no output, state or operation directory creation; retain positive inspect and prepare coverage.
